main_measure.name: mean excess 5-bar return after long bets (return minus coin's mean 5-bar return)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: positive with t >= 2 over at least 30 cases; reject: negative with t <= -2 over at least 30 cases

supporting_check.name: upper-half minus lower-half mean excess return (median split of entry forecast)

decided_by: Mean excess return positive with t >= 2 over at least 30 cases, and the upper-half-minus-lower-half difference is above 0.
reading: A case is the first long bet (forecast rise >= 2 points from its lowest level since the last bet, from 0 after flat) in each 5-bar grid cell counted from the window's first row, entered at that bar's close, with cases whose 5 bars run past the window dropped; the coin's mean 5-bar return uses the same grid pooled over its windows; the median split puts ties at the median in the lower half.
